meeting_date.text: April 17, 2013 (originally scheduled March 7, 2013; postponed due to inclement weather)

quote.quote: A Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) was held on April 17, 2013.

recommendation.text: The committee voted favorably on efficacy for airflow obstruction in COPD (12-1-0), reduction of COPD exacerbations (8-5-0), and adequacy of safety (10-3-0); on approvability it voted 9-4-0 for airflow obstruction and 8-5-0 for reduction of COPD exacerbation.

quote.quote: On voting questions, the Committee voted favorably regarding whether there was substantial evidence of efficacy for airflow obstruction in COPD (12 yes, 1 no, 0 abstain), for reduction of COPD exacerbations (8 yes, 5 no, and 0 abstain), and whether the safety of Breo had been adequately demonstrated (10 yes, 3 no, and 0 abstain).

summary: A Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) meeting was held April 17, 2013 (postponed from March 7 due to weather) to discuss the adequacy of the efficacy data for the airflow-obstruction and COPD-exacerbation indications, the adequacy of the safety database, and the overall benefit-risk of Breo Ellipta 100/25 mcg once daily. The committee voted favorably on all questions, including approvability for airflow obstruction (9-4-0) and for reduction of COPD exacerbation (8-5-0), and Breo Ellipta was approved for both requested indications. The review documents report the committee's discussion and votes but do not tie any specific committee concern to a particular change in the application; the product was approved as submitted, so no concern-to-change linkages are documented.
